newsitem.title: USA: First Union buys Meridian trust portfolio.
newsitem.headline: First Union buys Meridian trust portfolio.

text.p: First Union Corp said it completed its acquisition of Meridian Trust Company's corporate trust portfolio.
The acquisition consists of approximately 1,100 bond trustee and agency accounts for corporate and municipal issuers in Pennsylvania, New Jersey and Delaware.

First Union said that with the acquisition its corporate trust group has increased its market share in the northeast U.S. and expanded its corporate trust portfolio to more than 8,000 issuers and $125 billion in principal outstanding.
Neither First Union nor CoreStates Financial Corp, the seller, disclosed terms.
